task_definition.task_description: Please hold 2 Sony XM5 headphones for me, then prepare the recommended invoice request for my account using my email and Stripe, and then generate the best-discount invoice for 2 units. After that, place the order with the best discount using my credit card, check the current New York time, convert the timestamp to a readable date and time, and save that as a note titled “Trip Summary” tagged finance and travel.

user_input.query: Please hold 2 Sony XM5 headphones in the electronics category for me using product ID p_sony_xm5_blk. Then prepare the recommended invoice request for my account for user_id user_001 using my email user@example.com and Stripe, and generate the best-discount invoice for quantity 2. After that, place the order with the best discount using my credit_card. Also, check the current time in America/New_York, convert that timestamp into a readable date and time, and save it as a note titled Trip Summary tagged finance and travel.
user_input.title: Trip Summary
